help.title: Help
help.body:
## The three tabs

- **Re-play** shows recorded runs. Pick one in the library on the left, or press the button to load the run you opened last.
- **Create** is where you build your own run: write a task, choose a pattern, add and connect agents, then press Run.
- **Result** shows the answer and the numbers of a run. It is light green when there is a result to see.

## Using the replay

- **Play and pause** start and stop the replay. **Speed** slows it down or speeds it up.
- **Previous step and Next step** move one message at a time. **The bar** lets you jump to any point.
- **The agent cards** show who is working, waiting or done. Click a card to read that agent's steps, messages and output.
- **Click a step** to read its exact message.
- In a debate, a badge shows which round it is in.

## The library and the run menu

- The library lists the example runs and your own. Use the search box to filter it.
- The cog on a run opens the run menu: **About** (title, author, link and a description), **Export run** (a JSON file), **Use in Create** (opens the run's task and design on the Create tab), **Export definition** (only the task and the design) and, for your own runs, **Delete**.
- The arrow button imports a run from a JSON file. Export run leaves out your language, time zone and browser.

## Creating a run

- Choose a pattern: sequential, parallel, supervisor or debate. Each one starts from the agents it needs.
- Add agents from the palette and connect them with the arrow on each box. Drag the boxes to arrange them.
- Select an agent to change its model, web search, name and instructions. A free agent is yours to define.
- Under the diagram you see an estimate and the limits for the run. A run stops as soon as it reaches a limit, and what happened so far is saved.
- **Load definition** and **Clear definition** replace the task and the diagram.

## Settings

- **Your Anthropic API key**: by default it stays in this tab only. You can save it on this computer, encrypted with a passphrase.
- **Default limits** for steps, tokens and web searches.
- **Tooltips**: the message shown in the middle of the screen when a run ends can be turned off.
- **Backup** saves your runs and settings to a file and loads them back.

## Language

Use the language buttons at the top to switch between English and Czech. Your choice is remembered in your browser. Articles that are not translated yet are shown in English. In Learn, topics marked **is coming** describe something Agent Atlas does not do yet.

## Good to know

Watching a replay does not call any AI service, so it is free. Running your own experiment uses your own Anthropic key and costs money at Anthropic. Agent Atlas remembers your language, settings and runs only in this browser, and your key only if you choose to, encrypted with a password that cannot be recovered.
about.title: About Agent Atlas
about.body:
Agent Atlas is an educational project that helps to understand how AI agents work, communicate and are orchestrated.

## Educational use only

Agent Atlas is a learning tool. It is not meant for real work.

## Licences

- The code is open source under the MIT licence.
- The site text, articles and translations are under CC BY 4.0.
- The name and logo of Agent Atlas are not licensed for reuse.

## Legal

Read the [privacy policy](#/page/privacy), the [terms of use](#/page/terms) and the [imprint](#/page/imprint).

settings.securityNone: No key is saved on this device, so there is nothing to protect yet. Save a key on the API keys tab with Remember on this device ticked.

editor.hint: Add agents from the list. Drag an agent to move it. To connect, drag from the arrow button on an agent onto another agent, or tap the arrow and then tap the other agent. Tap a line to select it, then tap the cross to remove it. Press Delete or tap the red cross to remove the selected agent.

editor.addToPrevious: Add this critic's notes to the output of the agent before it
editor.addToPreviousHelp: The next agent, or the final answer, then gets that agent's text followed by the critic's notes. Without it only the critic's notes are passed on. It has no effect if the critic is the first agent.

design.error.node.addToPrevious: A critic can add its notes only in a sequential or parallel design.
design.error.edge.unknownNode: A connection points to an agent that is not in the diagram.
design.error.edge.self: An agent cannot be connected to itself.
design.error.edge.duplicate: These two agents are already connected.
design.error.seq.notChain: In a sequential run the agents must form one line: each agent passes its result to exactly one next agent, and no agent is left out or loops back.
design.error.par.combiner: A parallel run needs exactly one combiner.
design.error.par.workers: A parallel run needs at least two workers besides the combiner.
design.error.par.edges: In a parallel run every worker connects to the combiner. After the combiner, agents may follow in one line, each passing its result to the next. Nothing else is allowed.
design.error.sup.supervisor: A supervisor run needs exactly one supervisor.
design.error.sup.workers: A supervisor run needs at least one worker.
design.error.sup.edges: In a supervisor run the supervisor connects to every worker, and nothing else.
design.error.deb.debaters: A debate needs at least two debaters.
design.error.deb.judge: A debate needs exactly one judge.
design.error.deb.edges: In a debate every debater connects to the judge, and nothing else.

create.taskLabel: 1. Describe the task for the agents
create.patternHelp: The orchestration pattern decides how the agents work together: who works when and who sees what. It also decides which connections the diagram allows. Changing it clears the diagram.
create.pattern.sequential: One after another, each passes its result on.
create.pattern.parallel: Several work at the same time, one combines the results, and more agents may follow to review or polish.
create.pattern.supervisor: A supervisor hands out work and decides when it is done.
create.pattern.debate: Debaters argue in rounds, a judge decides.
create.patternChanged: The diagram was cleared because the orchestration pattern changed.
